payload.entry: Implemented themes suggest with shared capture task lookup, structured target/suggestion JSON and human output, read-only/path/broken-pipe coverage, discovery/help/catalog wiring, and vault-wide theme_default_unknown hints. Added a disposable per-vault note-facts cache with per-file mtime_ns/size checks, directory discovery fingerprints, fresh/corruption rebuilds, and reused cached root-area colors. Prior check 02334e71bcbc5f41a31de660230223be passed 3830 unit tests and 2367 CLI tests; its only failures were generated docs awaiting docs-gen and an incorrect BOBB similarity test expectation, now corrected to the existing plural-pair BOBS rule. Cache was added after that run and still needs validation. Clean baseline is b8d5529742330811a412d1364ea47eda1be8d5ef. Read-only source vault opened with sase repo: gh:bbugyi200/bob at e82788c473e996f94ec2951d86d14c03985c20e0. Scratch snapshot: 6778 files, 22560905 bytes, sha256 a9be1716f00bdeeb0a9bce7edc7f19b41422198fe78293b92dee25eacad07196. Initial Python I/O probe (not release evidence): 5338 eligible files/10174058 bytes, warmed content read median 154.525ms vs metadata 40.733ms. Remaining work fits one coder: run/inspect verification and optimized benchmark via target/theme-default-benchmark/verify_phase.py, fix any failures or timing delta above +5ms, inspect generated docs, record exact release p95 evidence, run epic-symbols and close only this bead, then sase_final. No memory notes or live vault were edited.

Verification recovery: monitor pq0s45qabygr passed docs-gen, docs-check, 51 theme-related tests, formatting/lint, 3830 unit tests, and all integration targets except help::root_help_matches_sectioned_short_and_long_snapshots (2371 CLI tests passed). Fixed both root-help fixtures to match the reviewed new description. Generated CLI docs inspected; no memory changes. IMPORTANT: prior full-scan/cached timing results are INVALID because all three copied release binaries had identical SHA-256 ca19e29258d103691f102a9f25a90a1723037f60a1278b1844552dc31af775a7: shared Cargo target reused baseline artifacts. Archived those results as invalid-identical-results.json. Benchmark now rejects identical binaries before measuring (verified guard), and verification script cleans own release packages between source builds, checks Cargo artifact provenance/freshness, requires three distinct hashes, and smoke-tests unknown-default behavior before timing. No epic-symbol entries found. Remaining work is corrected release measurements and inspection/closure; source implementation is unchanged.

Monitor m4jxjmv2sgdv passed the full canonical check after help snapshot repair. Valid release artifacts were distinct and profile-matched. Full-scan p95: baseline 29.391635 ms, revised 112.078393 ms, delta +82.686758 ms. Serial note-cache p95: baseline 34.974641 ms, revised 64.241381 ms, delta +29.266740 ms (FAILED +5 ms bound). Each used 10 warmups and 100 alternating samples per binary, fixed 2026-10-28 12:00:00 and identical config/snapshot: 6778 files, 22560905 bytes, SHA256 a9be1716f00bdeeb0a9bce7edc7f19b41422198fe78293b92dee25eacad07196; baseline b8d5529742330811a412d1364ea47eda1be8d5ef. Binary SHA256 baseline ca19e29258d103691f102a9f25a90a1723037f60a1278b1844552dc31af775a7; full-scan 835f0e913a24ad4c366bed1c95219fdb1a7a57a6f10f42384390e60c191c7988; serial cache c275d29aa5d6b116d4428dafd2af0032facded75ddd9091d85d7c81fc984ddd9. Trace confirmed 6626 metadata calls dominating warm work (5338 eligible note files). This recovery splits directory discovery from file refresh, uses at most four workers on large vaults, and overlaps note-facts loading with catalog loading without duplicate area scanning. All files remain checked every invocation; cache path is captured before threading. Added a 1100-note CLI regression for cold/warm equality, retyping/add/delete/default removal, fresh rebuild, unchanged vault bytes, and propagated read errors. Formatted and reviewed generated CLI docs (unchanged; their generated help blank line retains existing whitespace convention). Pending measured acceptance and full verification are prepared in target/theme-default-benchmark/verify_parallel.py; it preserves valid serial failure evidence, rebuilds only revised release binary with artifact/profile/hash checks, verifies actual frozen snapshot digest, smoke-tests unknown defaults, benchmarks, and runs check. No memory or live-vault changes. Remaining inspection/closure fits one coder.

COMPLETED VERIFICATION: Monitor 4w3drgh5qva0 (tool run dc35d33c4c7bfd25044386a67dd3d8f0) exited 0. Same-profile optimized release comparison on apollo: baseline p95 41.400022 ms; revised bounded-parallel cache p95 37.079298 ms; delta -4.320724 ms, meeting the <= +5 ms acceptance bound. Medians 26.382892 / 28.3768355 ms. Each binary had 10 warmups and 100 alternating measured samples, fixed BOB_NOW 2026-10-28 12:00:00, and identical config (plan.exempt=[PLAN], plan.max_themes=30). Frozen snapshot: 6778 files, 22560905 bytes, SHA-256 a9be1716f00bdeeb0a9bce7edc7f19b41422198fe78293b92dee25eacad07196. Clean baseline revision b8d5529742330811a412d1364ea47eda1be8d5ef. Binary SHA-256 baseline ca19e29258d103691f102a9f25a90a1723037f60a1278b1844552dc31af775a7; revised 6eb7096139778eeb0b60df1d223403c59243b94c71fb6e182e4ac93e252d2160. Cargo artifacts confirm distinct fresh binaries with matching release profiles; actual snapshot and binary hashes verified. Earlier full-scan (+82.686758 ms) and serial-cache (+29.266740 ms) failures remain evidence for the selected strategy; invalid identical-binary timings are excluded.

Canonical sase tool run check passed: 3830 unit tests (1 ignored), 2373 CLI tests, and all remaining integration/doc-test targets, including the 1100-note parallel-refresh/error/read-only regression. docs-gen/docs-check passed in pq0s45qabygr; generated CLI references and help snapshots re-inspected, and cli_reference_is_current passed in the final full check. Final source diff check passed. Shipped read-only bob themes suggest TARGET with shared capture lookup diagnostics, structured JSON/human explanations, and discovery/help/catalog/completion wiring. themes list adds deterministic vault-wide theme_default_unknown hints; disposable per-vault cache retains per-invocation mtime_ns/size checks for every eligible file, directory discovery fingerprints, fresh/corruption rebuilds, current-catalog knownness, and cached root-area hues. Completion/parse paths do not scan defaults. No canonical memory, live vault, version, or changelog changes; no new beads or ancestor closures.

Durable raw samples, earlier valid comparisons, build artifacts, and final statuses are attached as file:explicit:babfd9c7f9ecf3f6fe7fddcf, stored at /home/bryan/.sase/artifacts/agents/gh_bobs-org__bob-cli/20261028155420/phase-verification-evidence-27d0b381d296.json.
